lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Grand Theft Auto VI fever hits Toronto as gamers book time off work to play, Toronto Sun reports.
CTV News in China: Carney and Trump meet at APEC summit, CP24 reports.
The Competition Bureau says it has obtained a court order to advance an ongoing investigation into Old Navy and Gap, The Canadian Press reports.
Parliament’s budget watchdog found hundreds of billions of dollars in shadowy government borrowing that goes beyond the $62.3-billion deficit, Toronto Star reports.
Trump plans to meet separately with Putin on his China trip in addition to their 3-way talks with Xi, The Associated Press reports.
Ontario Premier Doug Ford tried to say a few lines in French during his speech in Montreal on Tuesday, CityNews Ottawa reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
